questions.text: Two circles have radii of 27 cm and 36 cm. The distance between their centres is 45 cm. What is the length (in cm) of their common chord?
When the integer n is divided by 5, the remainder is 3. What is the remainder if 6n is divided by 5?
The profit obtained by selling on article for ₹86 is twice the loss obtained by selling the same article for ₹53. Find the cost price.
The average of the first 10 natural numbers is _______.
A metallic solid cuboid of dimensions 36 cm × 22 cm × 12 cm is melted and recast in the form of cubes of side 6 cm. Find the number of the cubes so formed.

Suresh studies the pattern of daily sale of a shop. He finds that on Monday, the sale was decreased by 10% in comparison to the sale on Sunday. On Tuesday, the sale was increased by 10% in comparison to the sale of Monday. If the sale on Tuesday was of ₹1,485, how much was the sale on Sunday?
Identify a single-digit number other than 1, which may exactly divide the number173 + 183− 163 − 153.

Pranav gave 30% of the money he had to his wife, and 86% of the remaining to his two children. Half of the amount left was spent on other things, and the remaining amount of ₹98,000 was deposited in the bank. How much money did he have initially?
What will be the amount due on ₹12,000 in 2 years when the rate of simple interest on successive years is 9% and 10%, respectively?
Rohan takes 10 hours to mow a large lawn. He and Mohan together can mow it in 4 hours. How long will Mohan take to mow the lawn if he works alone?
Two numbers are in the ratio 2:3. Their sum is 135. Find the numbers.

A’s income is equal to 125% of the income of B, while B’s savings are 120% of the savings of A. If the expenditure of B is 75% of the expenditure of A, then how much are B’s savings as a percentage of her expenditure?
The ratio of the speeds of a boat while going upstream and going downstream is 2 : 3 and the sum of these two speeds is 15 km/h. What is the speed of the stream?
A two-digit number is 12 more than five times the sum of its digits. The number formed by reversing the digits is 9 less than the original number. The number is:

The length of a common external tangent to two circles of an equal radius of 5 units is equal to the diameter of the circle. Which of the following can be the distance between the centres of the circles in units?

X and Y are two points on the circumference of a circle having diameter 20 cm. The length of the line segment XY is 16 cm. Find the distance (in cm) of the line segment XY from the centre of the circle.
The perimeter of a square whose area is the same as the area of a semi-circle of radius 2√2 cm is:
